Name: OBS Control Room
Author: blessdog
Description: Bespoke OBS keys: one-press show flow, screen picker, live status, meeting mode. Companion to the Control Room scene collection.

Actions.Name: Show Flow
Actions.Tooltip: One press runs the show open: cold-start OBS, Starting Soon, countdown, go live. Hold 1.5s while live to end the show.

Actions.Name: Screen Picker
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle which display the Screen scenes capture: built-in or external.

Actions.Name: Status
Actions.Tooltip: OBS health at a glance: OFFLINE / READY / REC / LIVE with elapsed time and dropped frames. Press while offline to cold-start OBS.

Actions.Name: Meeting Mode
Actions.Tooltip: Prep a meeting share: Screen + Cam scene with the OBS Virtual Camera on. Press again to turn it off.

Actions.Name: Scene: Starting Soon
Actions.Tooltip: Cut to the Starting Soon lava-lamp holding scene. The on-air scene's key lights up.

Actions.Name: Scene: Screen
Actions.Tooltip: Cut to the full screen-share scene. The on-air scene's key lights up.

Actions.Name: Scene: Cam
Actions.Tooltip: Cut to the full camera scene. The on-air scene's key lights up.

Actions.Name: Scene: Screen + Cam
Actions.Tooltip: Cut to screen share with camera bubble. The on-air scene's key lights up.

Actions.Name: Scene: Lava Lounge
Actions.Tooltip: Cut to the lava lamp with your background-removed camera. The on-air scene's key lights up.

Actions.Name: Scene: Ending
Actions.Tooltip: Cut to the Ending scene. The on-air scene's key lights up.
